chunks: Ṣāliḥ ibn ʿUqbah narrated from Zayd al-Shaḥḥām, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: “What is for one who visits one of you?” He said: “Like one who has visited the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله.”

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh, Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.وَاحِدًا مِنْكُمْ: one among you, referring to one of the Imams عليهم السلام

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting one of the Imams in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that visiting one of the Imams عليهم السلام carries a rank comparable to visiting the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم. It highlights the sanctity and spiritual status of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام within Shia tradition.
